question: Evaluate $(\hat{i}+2\hat{j})\times(2\hat{i}-\hat{j})$.
explanation:
Step 1: Apply the distributive property of the vector product.
Step 2: The expression becomes $2(\hat{i}\times\hat{i})-(\hat{i}\times\hat{j})+4(\hat{j}\times\hat{i})-2(\hat{j}\times\hat{j})$.
Step 3: Use $\hat{i}\times\hat{i}=\vec{0}$, $\hat{j}\times\hat{j}=\vec{0}$, $\hat{i}\times\hat{j}=\hat{k}$ and $\hat{j}\times\hat{i}=-\hat{k}$.
Step 4: The expression reduces to $-\hat{k}-4\hat{k}$.
Final Answer: $(\hat{i}+2\hat{j})\times(2\hat{i}-\hat{j})=-5\hat{k}$.
